title.rendered: ePSXe 2.0.17 Full Apk PS1 Emulator Android

content.rendered:
Download ePSXe 2.0.17 apk which is PlayStation One emulator for Android, it runs smoothly without much lagging on many versions of Android device.

On ePSXe you can play numerous PS1 games that can be downloaded online which are either compressed or in the original bin format.

If they are compressed you can use Zarchiver App for Android to extract into any folder you can easily locate the bin file.

ePSXe Android Description

Play all your favorite Playstation games in your android device.

ePSXe for Android is a Playstation emulator (PSX and PSOne). It is a port of the famous ePSXe for PC. ePSXe provides very high compatibility (>99%), good speed, and accurate sound.

It is designed for smartphones and tablets, (for 1-4 players) including a fun 2 players option with split screen mode.

It includes virtual touchscreen pad support, hardware buttons mapping (Xperia Play, phones with keyboard or gamepad, external gamepads bluetooth or USB such as WiiMote, Sixaxis, Xbox 360, Moga, Ipega) and analog sticks. ePSXe includes native support for ARM and Intel Atom X86.

ePSXe supports HD enhanced graphics including 2x/4x software renderer and two OpenGL renderers, cheat codes as well as savestates and memcards compatibility with the PC version.

Download ePSXe Apk PlayStation Emulator For Android

Link below takes you the page where you can download latest ePSXe full Apk for Android all for free, comes with bios file.

ePSXe 2.0.17 Full Apk (9 MB)

How To Install ePSXe Apk Full Version With Bios File

After downloading the ePSXe apk app above, click on it to install and open it to automatically run bios file by following the on-screen instructions.

Then download any PS1 game on the internet and run it with the emulator.

Link To PS1 Emulator Game To Run in ePSXe App

Personally to be sure that ePSXe App is running PS1 games i myself have to download a game called Jackie Chan Stunt Master and the game played smoothly without lagging on my device. Click the link below to download it and run.

Download Jackie Chan Stunt Master Bin File Zip

Extract the file above with Zarchiver Apk App and load from the folder you Extract to with ePSXe Emulator App.
